tab_description: The repositories and folders agents in this workspace can work in.
repos_section_description: Repos an agent checks out in the cloud to do its work.
github_not_configured: GitHub connection is not configured for this deployment.
github_browse_not_configured: Repository browsing requires GITHUB_APP_ID and GITHUB_APP_PRIVATE_KEY.
github_connect_failed: Could not connect GitHub. Try again.
github_picker_description: Select repositories to attach to this workspace. Repositories already attached stay unchanged.

github_no_search_results: No loaded repositories match this search.
local_section_description: Folders on a machine running the Enact daemon. Each machine can attach one.
local_desktop_only_hint: Local directories can only be attached from the desktop app.
local_daemon_offline_hint: Start the local daemon to attach a directory on this machine.
local_daemon_already_attached_hint: This machine already has a local directory attached. Remove it before adding another.
local_no_daemon_tooltip: Local daemon isn't reporting an ID yet — the agent can't open this directory.
local_other_machine_tooltip: Only available on the machine that registered this directory.
chat_hint_worktree_prefix: Agent will work in an isolated worktree of
chat_hint_worktree_note: Your working copy stays untouched — each task hands its work back as an agent/… branch.
toast_local_already_attached: This directory is already attached to this workspace on this machine.
toast_local_daemon_already_attached: This machine already has a local directory attached to this workspace. Remove it before adding another.
local_validate_unsupported: Local directories can only be picked on the desktop app.
mode_dialog_title: How should tasks use this folder?
mode_dialog_description: This decides how you get an agent's work back, and whether tasks on this folder can run at the same time.
mode_in_place_description: One task at a time. Changes appear in your working copy as the agent makes them, ready for you to keep working on.
mode_worktree_description: Tasks run at the same time without touching your working copy. Each one hands back an agent/… branch in this repo for you to review and merge.
mode_worktree_needs_git: This folder is not a git repository, so there is nowhere to put the branch. Pick a repository, or keep editing the folder directly.
mode_worktree_needs_server_upgrade: Your Enact server is too old to run tasks in parallel — it would quietly run them in this folder instead. Update the server, then switch this on.
mode_edit_tooltip: Change how tasks use this folder
mode_badge_worktree_tooltip: Tasks run at the same time in their own git worktree and hand back a branch. Your working copy is untouched.
toast_local_mode_update_failed: Could not update the execution mode
knowledge_section_description: Repos of documents agents read as context. Attach one to an agent in its own settings — a knowledge base bound to nobody is never read.
